# omada_ssid (Data Source)

Looks up one SSID by ID or name within a WLAN group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_ssid" "iot" {
  wlan_group_id = data.omada_wlan_group.default.id
  name          = "Home-IoT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `wlan_group_id` (String) WLAN group ID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) SSID controller ID. Specify either id or name.
- `name` (String) SSID name. Specify either id or name.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.

### Read-Only

- `band` (Number)
- `broadcast` (Boolean)
- `enable_11r` (Boolean)
- `guest` (Boolean)
- `pmf_mode` (Number)
- `security` (Number)
- `vlan_enable` (Boolean)
- `vlan_id` (Number)
